description: This Java interface `SnapshotConfig` defines configuration settings for entity snapshot behavior, including snapshot interval and threshold, with default values specified in an inner enum.

classes.name: SnapshotConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods for entity snapshot settings.

classes.name: SnapshotConfig.SnapshotConfigValue
